def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 centers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,3)]
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c]: continue
   vert=[(abs(a-r),v) for a,b,v in centers if b==c]
   horiz=[(abs(b-c),v) for a,b,v in centers if a==r]
   cand=vert or horiz
   if cand: out[r][c]=min(cand)[1]
 return out
